test_results.observation: One AnsweringStore retrieval seam accepts query text and vector for vector-only and hybrid configurations; integration tests persist compatible provenance.
PostgreSQL retrieval tests verify Workspace, active Embedding Set, and embedding-configuration predicates within retrieval queries before candidate limits.
Hybrid integration proves `rrf-v1` dual-branch contribution, canonical deduplication, deterministic repeat ordering, and trace provenance.
Evidence Selection tests prove no post-fusion numeric threshold and independently exercise overlap, chunk-count, token-budget, empty-evidence refusal, provider refusal, and citation behavior.
Trace tests verify exact Workspace/trace correlation and persisted hybrid trace content excludes PostgreSQL implementation details.
The remediation test proves FTS filters foreign Workspace, inactive Embedding Set, and wrong embedding configuration rows before ranking and candidate_k; equal native ranks use chunk_id order.
